zh: 这一节把秒退、游走与完成，落成可重放的合成人群：新模块用固定种子生成六种画像，事件可直接用于热图推导；123 门内的观察台新增 240 人面板，呈现秒退、急躁、rage 与完成者，并列出三项改进优先级。612 项测试通过，静态页资产已替换，Pages 运行仍在 dispatch。合成人群不进公开段或模型包，不作真实归因，也不承诺趋势外推；Court 仍 LOCKED，exhibit 19 与 pinned reds 原样。它不是线上用户证词，而是有校准说明、离线可重放的模拟。
en: A reproducible crowd enters the ledger: `mulberry32(20261119)` shapes six personas into `HeatEvent`-compatible records in `apps/web/src/telemetry/syntheticCohort.ts`. Six tests pass, covering deterministic replay, persona shares, funnel direction, rage ownership, bouncers with no clicks, and impatient sessions (`syntheticCohort.test.ts`). In `pages/Observe.tsx`, a panel counts “240 visitors, nobody really exists”; its synthetic observations stay out of the public section, model packet, and real attribution. Around these entries, the open world is a map of doors, glances, wandering, and exits, not a claim about actual crowds. Its edges remain legible because each path is seeded, replayable, and kept apart from evidence about real people.
